searchText: I've gotten a little lost on terminology, specifically what we mean by "shard" in the context of Danksharding. Is a shard a single blob index over time (for example, shard 7 would always be the shard with index 7)? Or is it more like "the Arbitrum shard" where all blobs posted by Arbitrum taken together would be that shard? <dankrad> more like the first, I think It's not clear from the spec for me, whether we keep old `beacon_block` gossip topic and keep gossiping BeaconBlock without blobs too > All topics remain stable except the beacon block topic which is updated with the modified type. so we keep old one too? > The new topics along with the type of the data field of a gossipsub message are given in this table: > `beacon_block_and_blobs_sidecar` We don't know either. Need to clarify the spec. <inphi> > <inphi> We discussed at the 4844 call to not keep the old topic. We no longer wanna propagate or accept virgin beacon blocks after the 4844 upgrade (re @sharded_data_bot: <Dmitrii Shmatko> It's not clear from the spec for me, whether we keep old `beacon_block` gossip topic and keep gossiping BeaconBlock without blobs too > All topics remain stable except the beacon block topic which is updated with the modified type. so we keep old one too? > The new topics along with the type of the data field of a gossipsub message are given in this table: > `beacon_block_and_blobs_sidecar`) <dankrad> What is the idea for when we get full sharding? Are we going to strip it off again and go back to virgin blocks? <inphi> We didn't think that far ahead, but I assume so. In that case, we can keep using the same topic while leaving the blobs_sidecar field unset. <dankrad> right <dankrad> we should probably check that the transition that way is easy as well
